Origin Story

Who's Opalescence?

"Give me an event and a deadline and I'll give you a poster you'll actually remember."

I'm Arkadeep — Opalescence when I'm making things. Most of what I do comes down to posters: for college fests, club events, and anything that needed a visual and someone willing to stay up for it.

Alongside that I design logos, merch, character art, and general digital art whenever the mood or the brief calls for it. Nothing here started in a design studio — it started on a laptop between classes.

Right now I'm also currently managing the campus radio, the media house of IISERK, so a good chunk of my design work doubles as promotion for things I'm already running behind the scenes.
